intro: Sleeping well, healthy habits and how to give an opinion or advice.
p.sueño.consejo: It has two meanings: «tengo sueño» is wanting to sleep; «un sueño» is what you see while sleeping.
p.descanso.consejo: It comes from «descansar». It is also a school break or a pause at work.
p.almohada.consejo: The h is silent: «al-mo-A-da». It goes on the bed.
p.siesta.consejo: You say «dormir la siesta» or «echar una siesta».
p.despertador.consejo: It comes from «despertar». First the alarm rings and then you wake up.
p.horario.consejo: It is used for work, school and sleep: «un horario fijo».
p.cansancio.consejo: It comes from «cansarse». The adjective is «cansado».
p.rutina.consejo: A sleep routine is going to bed and getting up always at the same time.
p.saludable.consejo: It comes from «salud». It works for a man and a woman: «un hábito saludable».
p.hábito.consejo: It has an accent on the á: «A-bi-to». The h is silent.
p.descansar.consejo: You can rest without sleeping: reading or walking.
p.reducir.consejo: It is irregular: «yo reduzco». The subjunctive comes from it: «reduzca, reduzcamos».
p.acostarse.consejo: The o changes to ue: «me acuesto». In «acostarnos» it does not change.
b1.texto:
**Sueño** is part of health. A good **rutina** has a fixed **horario**: **acostarse** and getting up at the same time.

- The **despertador** rings in the morning.
- A short **siesta** can be a good **descanso**.
- If you sleep little, **cansancio** arrives.
- A **hábito saludable** is something good that you do every day.
- To sleep better, you have to **reducir** screen time.

To give opinions and advice: **es evidente que**, **es necesario que**, **hay que**, **deberíamos**.
b2.f1.texto: What time did you go to bed last night?
b2.f2.texto: I went to bed at two, after looking at my phone.
b2.f3.texto: You need to reduce your screen time.
b2.f4.texto: It is very hard for me to put my phone down at night.
b2.f5.texto: I set the alarm and leave my phone far from the bed.
b2.f7.texto: A short nap helps rest a lot.
b4.texto:
To give an opinion or advice there are four formulas:

- **Es evidente que** + indicative, if something is a fact: **es evidente que dormir bien ayuda**.
- **Es necesario que** + subjunctive, if you talk about what a person must do: **es necesario que descansemos más**.
- **Hay que** + infinitive, for everyone in general: **hay que acostarse temprano**.
- **Deberíamos** + infinitive, for friendly advice: **deberíamos leer un libro**.

The subjunctive is built from **yo**: reduzco → **reduzcamos**; duermo → **durmamos**.
b4.e0.texto: It is obvious that sleeping well improves the day.
b4.e2.texto: One must go to bed earlier.
b5.f0.texto: At three in the morning, the kitchen clock counts every second.
b5.f1.texto: Marcos tosses and turns in bed like a ship without direction.
b5.f2.texto: The pillow seems hard to him, like a stone.
b5.f3.texto: Through the window, the moon draws a white line on the floor.
b5.f4.texto: His head thinks of a thousand things at once, without rest.
b5.f5.texto: In the end he leaves his phone far from the bed and switches off the light.
b5.f6.texto: The silence fills the room like warm water.
b5.f7.texto: He breathes slowly and counts the waves of his own breathing.
b5.f8.texto: Little by little, his eyes close by themselves.
b5.f9.texto: When the sun comes up through the window, Marcos is sleeping with a calm smile.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Hunger is different: it goes away by eating.
b6.o1.refuerzo: That's it! Tiredness is a lack of energy.
b6.pregunta: How are you with a lot of tiredness?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Well done! «Es necesario que» asks for the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Descansamos» is indicative. Here you need the subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: After «que» you need a conjugated verb, not the infinitive.
b7.pregunta: You talk about a need. Which form is missing?
b8.traduccion: We should go to bed earlier
b9.pregunta: Which word describes a habit that is good for your health?
b10.frase: Es evidente que dormir bien ____ el día.
b10.o0.refuerzo: Yes! A sure fact goes in the indicative.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Mejore» is subjunctive; «es evidente que» asks for the indicative.
b10.o2.refuerzo: After «que» you need a conjugated verb.
b10.pregunta: It is a clear fact. Which form is missing?
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Reducimos» is the ordinary present, not the subjunctive.
b12.pregunta: What is the subjunctive of «reducir» for nosotros?
p.acostaste.consejo: Past of «acostarse». The «o» does not change in the past: «te acostaste» (but «me acuesto»).
p.acosté.consejo: Past of «acostarse». It has an accent on the «é» and the stress falls on it: «a-kos-TE».
p.reduzcas.consejo: Subjunctive of «reducir», from «reduzco»: «reduzca, reduzcas, reduzca, reduzcamos, reduzcan».
p.duermes.consejo: From «dormir». The «o» changes to «ue» when stressed: «duermo, duermes, duerme».
p.descansemos.consejo: Subjunctive of «descansar»: for -ar verbs the endings are «-e, -es, -e, -emos, -en».
p.madrugada.consejo: «De madrugada» means very early, before dawn. It is feminine: «la madrugada».
p.segundo.consejo: The «g» is hard and the «u» is pronounced: «se-GUN-do». It is also the word for «second» in order.
p.vueltas.consejo: «Dar vueltas» is to turn around or to toss and turn in bed. The «v» sounds like b.
p.barco.consejo: The «c» before «o» sounds like k: «BAR-ko». A «barca» is a small boat.
p.rumbo.consejo: It starts with a strong «rr»: «RRUM-bo». «Sin rumbo» is without direction.
p.dura.consejo: Feminine of «duro»: «duro, dura». It is the opposite of «blando» (soft).
p.piedra.consejo: The «ie» is one sound: «PYE-dra». It is feminine: «la piedra».
p.luna.consejo: It is feminine: «la luna». The sun is masculine: «el sol».
p.cabeza.consejo: The «z» sounds like «th»: «ka-BE-tha». The «b» is written with b, not v.
p.tibia.consejo: Feminine of «tibio»: «tibio, tibia». The «ia» is one syllable: «TI-bya».
p.fuerzas.consejo: From «fuerte», strong. In «sin fuerzas» you feel weak, with no energy left at all.
p.deberíamos.consejo: From «deber», to have to. The accent on «í» splits the vowels, so it has four syllables.
p.acostarnos.consejo: From «acostarse», to lie down. The ending «-nos» means «us», so it means we go to bed.
p.reduzcamos.consejo: From «reducir», to reduce. The «z» sounds like «th» in Spain, and «c» before «a» is a hard «k».
